ideas.idea: Add Disallow groups for other training crawlers (Google-Extended, CCBot, ClaudeBot, etc.) while leaving search bots allowed
ideas.why: robots.txt blocks only GPTBot while geo.config.json says to block training crawlers, so the gap is real and the fix is concrete.

ideas.idea: Add Bakery/LocalBusiness JSON-LD on home, Course/Event on classes, ItemList/Product on breads
ideas.why: The deliberate choices say having no JSON-LD is not a required fix.

ideas.idea: Add concrete visible facts: address, hours, pre-order details, bread list with ingredients and prices, class price, duration, dates and booking link
ideas.why: The pages are vague ("a wide range of loaves", "Book early" with no link), so specific text would help people and machines.

ideas.idea: Add a short FAQ to pages
ideas.why: The deliberate choices say having no FAQ is not a problem, so pushing one is folklore.

ideas.idea: Remove data-nosnippet from the allergen notice
ideas.why: The deliberate choices accept data-nosnippet on the allergen notice as a scoped choice.

ideas.idea: Rewrite the homepage title to include "Bakery" ("Millstone Bakery | Sourdough Bakery in York")
ideas.why: The existing title already has the brand and "sourdough in York", so the change has little effect.

ideas.idea: Make sure /img/loaves.jpg exists and has descriptive alt text
ideas.why: The alt text is already descriptive, and the file may simply be deployed separately, so this is a check rather than a fix.

ideas.idea: Add Open Graph and Twitter card metadata to public pages
ideas.why: This is accurate because the tags are missing, but it is standard advice for any site and affects share previews more than discovery.

ideas.idea: Add contextual internal links (home to classes, breads to classes, classes to booking)
ideas.why: The pages only link through the nav, and the home page links to breads but not classes, so contextual links are a concrete improvement.

ideas.idea: Drop the robots Disallow on /members/ and rely on noindex, or put it behind a login
ideas.why: The deliberate choices say /members being noindex and disallowed is correct, and this reverses it.
This is accurate since lastmod is absent, but it is standard sitemap advice with little effect on a 3-page site.

ideas.idea: Add an llms.txt summarizing the business
ideas.why: The deliberate choices say no llms.txt is not a problem, and it is presented as a way to help AI tools find the site.

ideas.idea: Choose one URL form (.html or extensionless) and use it consistently across canonicals, sitemap and nav
ideas.why: The site is already consistent in using .html URLs everywhere, so the advice has no effect here.
